final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT races.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM (SELECT DISTINCT raceId FROM constructorStandings) AS races LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = races.raceId AND cs.points > 6.0 GROUP BY races.raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_wins, ra.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS wins_difference FROM race_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
